titulo.alumno:
«Деепричастие и время действия»
Gerunds and the timing of actions

intro: The imperfective gerund usually indicates simultaneity; the perfective, an earlier or completed action, but context can clarify the nuance.

piezas.titulo: The imperfective gerund usually indicates simultaneity; the perfective, an earlier or completed action, but context can clarify the nuance.
texto: The imperfective gerund usually indicates simultaneity; the perfective, an earlier or completed action, but context can clarify the nuance.
The gerund keeps the subject of the main clause and belongs mainly to written register.
